note: Both sets cover essentially the same claims with the same strengths and the same defects: correct readings of the cap plate, bolts, pipe, angle, plate schedule and T.O. steel elevation, but each repeats the 1/2" plate, 1" plate and 3/8" plate thickness claims and each includes a spurious 'steel | diameter | 3"' claim that is really the 3" DIA STD. PIPE. Each also states the 4 X 3/8" cap plate thickness as a generic 'plate' claim with a vague '4 x' condition. Neither set captures the 3/4" HOLE or 1 1/2" HOLE callouts or the 2"/3" TYP spacing dimensions, so the omissions are equal as well.
remarks: Both extractions show the same pipeline artifacts: truncated quotes (e.g. '4 X 3/8" C', '3" DIA ST', '3/8" PL TY'), stray quote marks appended to values, and repeated claims arising from the same note appearing in multiple details (A1/A3/A5/C3). The 'steel | diameter | 3"' claim is a misbinding of the pipe callout in both sets. Both miss the 3/4" HOLE and 1 1/2" HOLE callouts and the 2" TYP / 3" TYP spacing dimensions shown in the details.
